progress: Mixed, the 2021-2025 action plan's horizon ended with no successor gazetted while a new national agenda went to strategic consultation
summary: The [action plan's horizon ended on 31 December 2025 with no successor, extension or evaluation held](2025-03-26-cpv-eurico-monteiro-governacao-electronica-cplp), and a [new agenda went to consultation in August 2026](2026-08-07-consulta-estrategica-sobre-o-futuro-digital-de-cabo-verde).
developments:
The plan of record was [presented to a lusophone interministerial meeting in March 2025 with interoperability between systems and electronic authentication as its stated components](2025-03-26-cpv-eurico-monteiro-governacao-electronica-cplp). Its horizon ended and no successor plan, extension or evaluation is held, so the 2026 digital-nation statements run without a current published action plan.

2026-08-06 - a [strategic consultation was convened in Praia seating public administration, private sector, academia and named specialists, whose contributions are to feed a national diagnosis and the priorities of an agenda covering modernisation and interoperability, service digitisation, digital skills, business innovation, digital inclusion, data protection and cybersecurity](2026-08-07-consulta-estrategica-sobre-o-futuro-digital-de-cabo-verde). No draft, title, adoption date or budget is held.

The [digital economy strategy is named as an orienting instrument of a bank programme with no adoption instrument, publication date or text held](2026-03-18-bad-financia-segunda-fase-reforma-electronica-177-milhoes-expressodasilhas), and the [governance framework whose terms of reference the finance ministry issued has produced no document and no record that its service team was established](2025-01-01 Cabo Verde MoF - ToR National Governance Framework for Digital Transformation).

summary: A [national 5G strategy was approved by resolution on 20 February 2026](2026-02-16-national-5g-strategy-digital-nation-techafricanews), targeting 90% internet penetration by 2026.
developments:
The strategy was [presented as a proposal at the technology park on 10 September 2025 under a World Bank-financed project](2025-09-10-cpv-estrategia-nacional-5g-hub-digital-regional-2030) and [approved by resolution on 20 February 2026, targeting 90% internet penetration by 2026 and regional digital-hub status by 2030, with the economic impact put by government at more than CVE 77 billion by 2036](2026-02-16-national-5g-strategy-digital-nation-techafricanews).

No spectrum assignment, licence award or network build is on file. The [penetration target cannot be tested](2025-09-11-national-5g-strategy-hub-2030-techafricanews) because the base holds no regulator quarter later than the second of 2025.

summary: Drafting of a [national artificial-intelligence strategy was kicked off at an EU-supported meeting in April 2026](2026-05-04-national-data-ai-strategies-techafricanews), with no draft text held.
developments:
None was published at the window's opening; a [named analyst noted in April 2025 that more than sixty countries had national strategies and argued this one should adopt one](2025-04-07-revolucao-tecnologica-opiniao-expressodasilhas).

2026-04-28 - [drafting was kicked off with senior officials, the Secretary of State for the Digital Economy, external consultants and European Union representatives, the government stating the framework will be designed for responsible and ethical use in the public interest](2026-05-04-national-data-ai-strategies-techafricanews). No draft text, timetable or budget is held.

It was paired with the data strategy in one kick-off and the two are separate instruments, so both now stand at the same stage: launched, unpublished and undated.

progress: Mixed, a data strategy for the public administration was kicked off while the data-governance diploma announced for 2024 is still unadopted
summary: A [data strategy kicked off on 28 April 2026](2026-05-04-national-data-ai-strategies-techafricanews), while the [diploma announced as a 2024 deliverable is unadopted](2023-11-17-cpv-ministra-edna-oliveira-comissao-especializada-oe2024).
developments:
2026-04-28 - a [development process was launched with senior officials, the Secretary of State for the Digital Economy, external consultants and European Union representatives, its stated goal to move government from siloed systems to integrated collection and use of data across departments](2026-05-04-national-data-ai-strategies-techafricanews). No draft, adoption date or lead institution is published.

The binding instrument has not moved: a [diploma regulating data governance in the public administration was announced for drafting in 2024 and is unadopted at 2026-08-06, as is a companion diploma on documentary classification announced in the same statement](2023-11-17-cpv-ministra-edna-oliveira-comissao-especializada-oe2024). It is a distinct instrument from the data-protection law the commission enforces, and its absence is what leaves the strategy without a rule to write into.

summary: An [open-data portal named as a 2024 deliverable has not been delivered two years past its stated year](2023-11-17-cpv-ministra-edna-oliveira-comissao-especializada-oe2024).
developments:
The portal was [named as a 2024 deliverable to the National Assembly's First Committee, alongside a database of public bodies, an integrated public-services portal and a human-resources database](2023-11-17-cpv-ministra-edna-oliveira-comissao-especializada-oe2024).

No open-data portal is held two years past that year. Of the four deliverables named together, the integrated services portal did arrive in February 2026, so the failure is specific to open data rather than to the programme as a whole. No policy, licence, catalogue or publication obligation exists in its place.

summary: [Lei 133/V/2001 is unamended in the window](2025-02-02-cnpd-faustino-varela-ia-big-data-direitos-expressodasilhas), last changed in 2021 to require designation of data-protection officers.
developments:
The [general regime closely mirrors the European standard, with administrative fines of CVE 50,000 to 3,000,000, cessation, blocking and deletion measures and criminal penalties up to two years, amended in 2013 to create the commission and in 2021 to require designation of data-protection officers](2024-01-01 Cabo Verde data protection - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (IBA)).

No amendment is recorded in the window. A [named analyst argued in April 2025 for aligning it with artificial intelligence and adding mechanisms for algorithmic supervision](2025-04-07-revolucao-tecnologica-opiniao-expressodasilhas); no bill is held. The [commission's president said in February 2025 that several institutions had not complied with the officer obligation](2025-02-02-cnpd-faustino-varela-ia-big-data-direitos-expressodasilhas).

summary: The [interoperability standards diploma announced for 2024 is unadopted](2023-11-17-cpv-ministra-edna-oliveira-comissao-especializada-oe2024) while interoperability is asserted as working.
developments:
The diploma was [announced for drafting in 2024 under the state-modernisation strategy, with no adoption on record](2023-11-17-cpv-ministra-edna-oliveira-comissao-especializada-oe2024).

There is no evidence it was adopted two years past its stated year, while [interoperability is asserted as a working property of the government portal](2026-02-24-governo-lanca-portal-govcv-modernizar-servicos-publicos-expressodasilhas) and of the company registry. The gap between an asserted interoperability layer and an unadopted standards instrument is the finding: what public systems must do to connect, and who decides, is set by nothing published.

summary: Legal frameworks for digital services, e-commerce and digital banking are [named among the 5G strategy's declared reach](2026-02-16-national-5g-strategy-digital-nation-techafricanews); no bill is held.
developments:
The frameworks were [declared as a component of the 5G strategy presented in September 2025](2025-09-10-cpv-estrategia-nacional-5g-hub-digital-regional-2030) and are [named among the declared reach of the strategy approved on 20 February 2026, alongside a regulatory and business framework to support investment](2026-02-16-national-5g-strategy-digital-nation-techafricanews). No bill, draft or diploma is held: it is a stated legislative programme covering three fields, not a named instrument.

Against that, a [dedicated startup law with tax benefits, a special technology economic zone, modern data-protection and digital-transactions laws, simplified business registration and a digital-nomad visa are all stated to be in place](2025-07-31-boost-cv-startup-ecosystem-wearetech), with no instrument number, adoption date, text or take-up figure for the startup law or the visa. That position rests entirely on a minister's summary in trade press.

progress: No change, a standing statute the base holds for the first time
summary: The national statistical system rests on [Lei 48/IX/2019, gazetted on 19 February 2019](2019-02-19-cpv-bo-lei-48-ix-2019-sistema-estatistico-nacional).
developments:
[Lei 48/IX/2019 was gazetted in Boletim Oficial n.o 18 on 19 February 2019 as the governing statute of the national statistical system](2019-02-19-cpv-bo-lei-48-ix-2019-sistema-estatistico-nacional).

The base carries the statute and the statistical development strategy for 2022-2026, and nothing testing either against practice: no independent evaluation of the statistics institute is held, and the ledger carries that absence as a separate open row.

progress: No change, a standing statute the base holds for the first time
summary: Cabo Verde has a dedicated access-to-information statute: [Lei 10/X/2022 regulates access to and re-use of administrative documents](2022-05-16-cpv-bo-lei-10-x-2022-acesso-reutilizacao-documentos-administrativos).
developments:
[Lei 10/X/2022, gazetted in Boletim Oficial n.o 47 on 16 May 2022, regulates access to and re-use of administrative documents and administrative information held by the bodies and entities listed in its article 2](2022-05-16-cpv-bo-lei-10-x-2022-acesso-reutilizacao-documentos-administrativos).

The base holds the gazette's own summary of the law and not its text: the full-issue capture stops before the law begins, and no per-act text was reachable. Nothing on the file states how the right is exercised in practice, what the response times are, or whether any refusal has been appealed.

summary: The commission's [powers are unchanged](2025-03-19-cnpd-dialogo-governanca-dados-regulacao-ia-expressodasilhas) and its appropriation stands at [CVE 36,313,115 for FY2025](2024-12-30-cpv-2025-cnpd), with FY2026 unestablished.
developments:
The commission has been an [independent supervisory authority since 2015-16, with fining powers and referral of possible criminal matters to the public prosecution, and is a member of the Global Privacy Assembly](2025-02-02-cnpd-faustino-varela-ia-big-data-direitos-expressodasilhas). Its [president stated it was entering a phase more attentive to digital innovation and named retention of technical staff as a standing constraint, every technician who started in 2016 having left](2025-03-19-cnpd-dialogo-governanca-dados-regulacao-ia-expressodasilhas).

It was [appropriated CVE 36,313,115 for FY2025 inside the National Assembly's own private budget rather than through any ministerial vote, a 3.0% uplift on CVE 35,255,451 for FY2024, with zero own-source revenue in both years](2024-12-30-cpv-2025-cnpd); against the fining powers the statute confers, that is roughly a dozen maximum penalties. The [FY2026 volume contains no occurrence of the commission in 266 pages, so its FY2026 appropriation is unestablished](2024-12-30-cpv-2025-cnpd). On its own site it has published no genuine activity report since 2016.

summary: The judicial police [still have no effective access to the national video-surveillance system](2026-05-13-pj-acesso-videovigilancia-investigacao-criminal-anacao), two years after a formal request.
developments:
A formal request was made to the Interior Minister in mid-2024 and the force had no effective access. 2026-05-13 - the claim was [restated by the national director at the force's 33rd anniversary with still no access granted, the Justice Minister calling it justified and saying steps were under way with the Interior Ministry, which manages the system, alongside expansion projects in several cities and islands](2026-05-13-pj-acesso-videovigilancia-investigacao-criminal-anacao).

No legal basis, safeguard or data-protection opinion on inter-institutional image sharing is held. A surveillance estate now being extended under a third financed phase, with no published rule on who may see it, is the readiness position.

summary: A [digital corridor with Nigeria launched in September 2025](2025-09-09-nigeria-cape-verde-digital-corridor-wearetech), and an [island-economies programme launched in July 2026](2026-07-24-auda-nepad-island-economies-programme-launch).
developments:
2025-09 - a [support agreement was signed in Abuja launching a corridor with cooperation priorities of artificial intelligence, youth empowerment and bilateral development, its declared deliverables training of over 500 secondary students on three islands, science and technology tools in Portuguese with teacher training, and a business and innovation mission in Praia](2025-09-09-nigeria-cape-verde-digital-corridor-wearetech), the [mission having been announced at an artificial-intelligence summit](2025-09-02-cabo-verde-government-leadership-ai-summit-nigeria-anacao). The base holds no record that either deliverable was delivered, and it is promoted by a private organisation rather than by a treaty instrument.

2026-07-24 - a [programme for African developing island economies launched with a 2026-2031 roadmap covering this and six other island states, on six pillars including connectivity](2026-07-24-auda-nepad-island-economies-programme-launch); no country-specific commitment, allocation or project is named.

progress: No change, a standing position the base holds for the first time
summary: The National Assembly [approved accession to the AU Malabo Convention by Resolucao 153/IX/2020](2020-03-17-cabo-verde-boletim-oficial-resolucao-153-ix-2020-adesao-convencao-malabo).
developments:
[Resolucao 153/IX/2020, gazetted on 17 March 2020, approves accession to the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection and publishes the Convention's full Portuguese text](2020-03-17-cabo-verde-boletim-oficial-resolucao-153-ix-2020-adesao-convencao-malabo) — the national act by which Cabo Verde harmonises to the regional instrument.

What the base does not hold: any act of ratification or transposition of an ECOWAS supplementary act on data protection or electronic transactions, and nothing on accession to Council of Europe Convention 108, which the ledger carries as an open row.

summary: [ISO 27001 certification of the state operator's public-key infrastructure, committed in its 2024 plan, is unconfirmed](2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024).
developments:
Certification was [committed in the operator's plan for 2024 and funded from its own trading account](2024-01-01-cpv-nosi-plano-anual-atividades-orcamento-2024-source), and [neither the FY2024 accounts nor the FY2026 plan record it as obtained](2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024).

The [country-code domain management system, launched by the regulator in May 2024 with a designated body handling all registrations, is likewise unchanged, with no registration volume, fee schedule or operational report held](2024-06-02-cpv-sistema-de-gestao-de-dominios-cv-edna-oliveira). The two are the only international-standard or internet-governance commitments the base records for this country, and neither has produced a published result.

summary: A [digital week was instituted as an annual national platform by resolution](2026-02-13-semana-do-digital-anual-resolucao-expressodasilhas), and the [advisory council met in November 2025](2025-11-26-cpv-economia-digital-pilar-estrategico-olavo-correia).
developments:
2026-02 - the digital week was [instituted by resolution as an annual national platform with five stated objectives covering digital literacy, public-sector modernisation, digitalisation of the economy, startup support and monitoring of the digital strategy](2026-02-13-semana-do-digital-anual-resolucao-expressodasilhas), having been held as an event with no standing instrument before; the [2026 edition ran 9 to 15 March in hybrid format, opening on Brava](2026-03-09-comeca-semana-do-digital-2026-expressodasilhas). It is financed from the state budget and partnerships, and no budget line for it is identified in any budget document held.

2025-11-25 - the [digital economy advisory council, chaired by the responsible minister, held its third ordinary meeting, at which the state set its programme on three pillars - digital public services, e-commerce and digital payments - supported by four declared work areas](2025-11-26-cpv-economia-digital-pilar-estrategico-olavo-correia); no meeting after that date is recorded.

summary: An [Open Government Partnership Forum met for the seventh time in February 2026 to prepare a third national action plan](2026-02-27-cabo-verde-forum-ogp-governacao-aberta-iii-plano-de-acao).
developments:
[The Forum met in Praia on 26 February 2026 to reformulate its membership and prepare the third National Action Plan for Open Government, the second having been completed in 2025](2026-02-27-cabo-verde-forum-ogp-governacao-aberta-iii-plano-de-acao). The Minister for State Modernisation argued at it that citizens can only criticise, support or propose alternatives to government policy if they have access to the underlying information.

[eParticipa is separately in service as a web and mobile channel between the citizen and the public administration](2026-01-01-cabo-verde-eparticipa-plataforma-participacao-cidada).

The base holds no public-consultation register and no count of consultations run or responses received.

progress: Mixed, the first cybersecurity budget line was inscribed for FY2026 while the digital ministry's vote fell 87.5% across two budgets and every digital programme was cut
summary: The digital ministry's vote fell to [CVE 174,200,533 for FY2026, an 87.5% fall across two budgets](2026-05-15-cpv-conta-provisoria-i-trimestre-2026-source), while a [first cybersecurity line of CVE 20,000,000 was inscribed](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-ciber-seguranca).
developments:
The ministry went from [CVE 1,390,965,632 in FY2024 to CVE 369,781,930 for FY2025](2024-12-30-cpv-lei-45-x-2024-orcamento-do-estado-2025-source) and [CVE 174,200,533 for FY2026, an 87.5% fall across two budgets while total state expenditure rose 11.3%, leaving the digital vote at 0.18% of state spending against 1.62% in FY2024, capital printed at zero for a second year, and a reprogrammed budget of CVE 1,614,624,282 at 31 March 2026, 9.3 times the voted figure](2026-05-15-cpv-conta-provisoria-i-trimestre-2026-source).

Every digital programme was cut: the [innovation platform programme to CVE 513,994,724 with no external borrowing](2025-12-31-cpv-lei-69-x-2025-orcamento-do-estado-2026-source), the [state-modernisation programme by 82% to CVE 976,042,125](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-modernizacao-estado-administracao-publica), the [statistical-system programme to CVE 290,706,686](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-sistema-informacao-desenvolvimento-sustentavel).

Against that, [CVE 20,000,000 was inscribed as a new cybersecurity budget unit, the first such line in the budget, at 0.02% of state expenditure](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-ciber-seguranca), and a [rectificative budget was approved on 31 July 2026 at CVE 103,888 million, naming connectivity among the priorities and giving no digital figure](2026-07-31-cpv-parlamento-aprova-orcamento-retificativo-2026). The [civil-identification earmark is rolled forward at CVE 306,516,802 for FY2026, identical to the escudo](2025-12-31-cpv-lei-69-x-2025-orcamento-do-estado-2026-source), while the [state operator forecasts service revenue of CVE 1,094,297,000 for 2026, 6.3 times the ministry's whole vote, its state-protocol line frozen for a third year](2026-01-01-cpv-nosi-plano-atividades-orcamento-2026-source).

summary: The state operator [signed a memorandum with Angola's public finance technology body in March 2026](2026-03-06-nosi-setic-fp-angola-memorando-entendimento-expressodasilhas), and a [tech-diplomacy protocol was signed](2026-03-18-tech-ambassador-global-institute-techreviewafrica).
developments:
2026-03-03 - a memorandum was [signed in Praia by the operator's executive administrator and the Angolan body's director-general in the presence of Angola's ambassador, covering cybersecurity, data-centre management, audit and internal control, and customer service](2026-03-06-nosi-setic-fp-angola-memorando-entendimento-expressodasilhas), the two bodies having been in contact since 2023 with no instrument on the record; it is [reported again in an account of Angola's own reform](2026-03-30-angola-pushes-digital-reform-with-new-public-finance-innovation-hub). No value, duration or workplan is stated.

2026-03 - a [protocol on membership was signed in Praia and a technology ambassador designated, described by the institute as the second such appointment in Africa](2026-03-18-tech-ambassador-global-institute-techreviewafrica); no fee, obligation or term is stated and the signature date is not given.

summary: A [sovereign guarantee of up to EUR 37 million was approved for the incumbent](2026-04-21-estado-aval-37-milhoes-cvtelecom-telecomunicacoes-expressodasilhas), drawing a public objection from its competitor.
developments:
2026-04-20 - a resolution [approved a guarantee of up to EUR 37 million for modernisation of telecommunications infrastructure, named as renewal of the inter-island submarine cable and reinforcement of international connectivity, each drawn tranche maturing within fifteen years and the project framed under a European gateway programme](2026-04-21-estado-aval-37-milhoes-cvtelecom-telecomunicacoes-expressodasilhas). No drawdown against it is held.

The [competitor objected publicly, demanding neutrality, transparency and separation of strategic infrastructure management from commercial service provision](2026-05-02-unitel-t-mais-neutralidade-concorrencia-telecomunicacoes-anacao), and no regulatory response to the objection is on file.

A [one-stop shop for startups was announced, staffed by newly hired specialists to route founders to finance instruments that already exist, with no legal instrument, location, staff complement, budget or opening date](2026-03-11-cpv-governo-dispoe-10-milhoes-de-contos-para-investir-no-digital).

progress: Mixed, a second-phase e-governance programme was signed and an innovation fund began disbursing while a EUR 37m connectivity loan stands at zero disbursement
summary: A [second-phase e-governance programme was signed on 31 December 2025](2026-03-18-bad-financia-segunda-fase-reforma-electronica-177-milhoes-expressodasilhas), while a [EUR 37m connectivity loan records zero disbursement](2024-01-01-eib-cpv-001-cabo-verde-regional-digital-connectivity).
developments:
The programme was [board-approved on 1 December 2025 at EUR 17.71 million and signed on 31 December, published in the official gazette of 17 March 2026, its components an e-justice system, a call for technology-park operators, digital-nomad regulation and public-finance modernisation](2026-03-18-bad-financia-segunda-fase-reforma-electronica-177-milhoes-expressodasilhas); [disbursement was still recorded as zero as accessed 24 June 2026](2025-01-01-afdb-cpv-007-cabo-verde---e-governance-and-public).

The innovation fund was [confirmed from the recipient side as a EUR 24 million fund to back startups and attract digital nomads inside a EUR 156 million programme, with US$6,915,466 disbursed](2025-10-06-fundo-morabeza-24-milhoes-startups-expressodasilhas).

The [EUR 37,000,000 framework loan signed in September 2024 within a EUR 80 million total cost, financing a submarine-cable branch, transmission modernisation and an incumbent systems upgrade, records zero disbursement and no drawdown, works-start or completion](2024-01-01-eib-cpv-001-cabo-verde-regional-digital-connectivity). The [flagship project is still financing activity past its recorded closing date](2026-01-30-skodji-digital-launch-techreviewafrica).

summary: The regulator counted [588,603 active SIMs at 113.9% penetration at the end of March 2026](2026-08-05-arme-indicadores-estatisticos-comunicacoes-eletronicas-1o-trimestre-2026), down 0.8% on the quarter.
developments:
[ARME's Q1 2026 market indicators, published on 5 August 2026, count 588,603 active SIM cards at a penetration rate of 113.9%, a fall of 0.8% against the fourth quarter of 2025 and a rise of 0.2% against the same quarter a year earlier, with CVTelecom holding 68% of active SIMs and Unitel T+ 32%](2026-08-05-arme-indicadores-estatisticos-comunicacoes-eletronicas-1o-trimestre-2026).

The quarterly series had stopped at Q2 2025 in the base and now resumes. Nothing in it is broken down by island or municipality, which the ledger carries as an open row.

progress: Mixed, subscriptions up on the quarter and down on the year
summary: The regulator counted [511,702 internet subscriptions at the end of March 2026, up 1% on the quarter and down 4% on the year](2026-08-05-arme-indicadores-estatisticos-comunicacoes-eletronicas-1o-trimestre-2026).
developments:
[ARME's Q1 2026 indicators count 511,702 internet access subscriptions, 86% of them delivered over mobile broadband on a small screen, a rise of 1% against the fourth quarter of 2025 and a fall of 4% against the same quarter of 2025 — mobile broadband subscriptions fell 16.4% year on year while fixed broadband rose 12.9%](2026-08-05-arme-indicadores-estatisticos-comunicacoes-eletronicas-1o-trimestre-2026). [Market shares by subscription are CVTelecom 72%, Unitel T+ 27.3% and Starlink 0.64%, with Starlink up 0.20 percentage points on the quarter](2026-08-05-arme-indicadores-estatisticos-comunicacoes-eletronicas-1o-trimestre-2026).

The shift from mobile to fixed broadband is the movement in the quarter; the base holds no household or individual-use survey against which to read it.

progress: No change, a standing position the base holds for the first time
summary: [EllaLink came ashore at Praia on 18 February 2021 with a stated 30 TB capacity](2021-02-19-cabo-verde-cabo-submarino-ellalink-aterragem-praia-capacidade).
developments:
[The EllaLink submarine cable came ashore at Portinho beach, Achada Grande Tras, in Praia on 18 February 2021; the Secretary of State for Innovation called it a historic moment for the country's telecommunications, and the government's record gives the low-latency fibre system a capacity of 30 TB, more than all existing cables combined](2021-02-19-cabo-verde-cabo-submarino-ellalink-aterragem-praia-capacidade). [A second ECOWAS regional submarine cable reached feasibility-study validation at a Monrovia workshop in October 2025](2025-10-22-ecowas-segundo-cabo-submarino-validacao-estudo-cabo-verde).

No inventory naming every system serving Cabo Verde, its landing station and its in-service date is held, and no lit or used capacity figure is on file for any of them.

summary: The satellite entrant [reached 0.2% of internet subscriptions by June 2025](2025-09-18-starlink-conquista-02-mercado-internet-arme-q2-2025-expressodasilhas), and the regulator [opened a consultation on satellite rules](2026-08-05-cape-verde-arme-satellite-communications-consultation).
developments:
The entrant [began activity in January 2025 under a general authorisation granted in 2024 and holds 0.2% of internet subscriptions at 30 June 2025, up 0.12 percentage points on the quarter in a market of 484,929 subscriptions](2025-09-18-starlink-conquista-02-mercado-internet-arme-q2-2025-expressodasilhas); the [Prime Minister had reported entry as an accomplished fact in November 2024](2024-11-06-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2025) while the regulator dates commercial start to January 2025. No market-share figure later than that quarter is held.

2026-08-05 - the regulator [opened a public consultation on licensing, radio-spectrum use, frequency coordination, user protection, network security and emergency communications for satellite operators, submissions to 31 August 2026, a direct response to the December 2024 launch](2026-08-05-cape-verde-arme-satellite-communications-consultation); no draft text or adoption date is published.

summary: The state operator forecasts [hosting and cloud revenue of CVE 127,494,000 for 2026, up 5.1%](2026-01-01-cpv-nosi-plano-atividades-orcamento-2026-source), inside a total forecast down 26%.
developments:
The [Praia data centre is in operation and Tier III certified, having billed connectivity of CVE 305,779,000 and protocolled state services of CVE 455,964,000 in the year to 31 December 2024](2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024). No accounts have been published since that volume, so no later certification, capacity or utilisation statement is held, and no floor area, rack count or installed electrical load is stated for any facility in the country.

Hosting and cloud lines move up while the whole forecast moves down: [housing CVE 26,994,000, infrastructure services 72,025,000, platform services 9,359,000 and software services 19,116,000 for 2026, CVE 127,494,000 combined and up 5.1%](2026-01-01-cpv-nosi-plano-atividades-orcamento-2026-source) against [CVE 121,274,000 forecast for 2025](2025-01-01-cpv-nosi-plano-atividades-orcamento-2025-source). Both are board forecasts, not outturn, and untested.

summary: A [photovoltaic self-consumption project for the Praia data centre was board-approved for 2025](2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024) and nothing establishes it was implemented.
developments:
The project was [approved by the operator's board with implementation scheduled within the 2025 exercise, aimed at cutting fossil-sourced electricity to at least 35% of the data centre's cost structure](2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024).

The operator's 2025 accounts are not published, so neither implementation nor any generation figure is established. The stated target is ambiguous between a share and a reduction and the accounts do not resolve it. It is the only energy statement of any kind attached to digital infrastructure in this country's record.

summary: The [election results portal became unreachable during results publication on 17 May 2026](2026-05-18-nosi-alegado-ciberataque-divulgacao-resultados-legislativas-anacao) and is under forensic audit.
developments:
The state operator's stated performance was publication of election results within two hours. The [portal became unreachable from about 19:00 on 17 May 2026 during legislative-election results publication and was restored by about 21:00](2026-05-18-nosi-alegado-ciberataque-divulgacao-resultados-legislativas-anacao); its [president initially said a cyber-attack was more likely than a technical fault](2026-05-25-nosi-ainda-nao-divulgou-conclusoes-anomalias-noite-eleitoral-anacao), and nine days later the [board's preliminary report pointed to technical causes and found no evidence of external malicious action, with internal conduct still being examined and an external independent technical and forensic audit under way](2026-05-27-nosi-relatorio-preliminar-causas-de-ordem-tecnica-anacao).

The systems that failed sit on the [open-source microservices framework on which the state's e-government applications are built and managed across their lifecycle](2025-03-26-cpv-eurico-monteiro-governacao-electronica-cplp), which no later source revises.

summary: A [national security operations centre and incident response team were launched in October 2025](2025-10-31 Cabo Verde launches national SOC and CSIRT), five years after the decree providing for them.
developments:
The [2021 decree established the cybersecurity legal regime and created the national response team, with no budget line at any grain of the FY2024 or FY2025 volumes and the money sitting inside the state operator's trading account](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-ciber-seguranca); the instrument itself is not held and is known only through the budget and operator records that recite it.

2025-10-30 - both bodies were [launched inside the state's private technological network, built by the operator with World Bank involvement, the operations centre for real-time detection and the response team as a national alert-and-response point](2025-10-30-governo-lanca-soc-csirt-rtpe-nosi-expressodasilhas). No incident count, staffing figure or service catalogue has been published since.

A [technical mission to South Korea covering data governance, service digitisation and cybersecurity produced no formal agreement](2025-07-09-south-korea-digital-cooperation-wearetech).

summary: [PDEX is in service as the state data-exchange platform, with four integrations named live](2026-01-01-cabo-verde-pdex-plataforma-interoperabilidade-do-estado).
developments:
[PDEX lets data owners publish their holdings as APIs under conditions they set, with subscription and consumption enforced against those conditions; it names four live integrations — the consular portal, whose civil-identification integration runs entirely through it, the NhaCard platform's traffic with the national health system, the Treasury's DUC collection system, and citizen and company validation APIs already consumed by public and private entities](2026-01-01-cabo-verde-pdex-plataforma-interoperabilidade-do-estado).

The platform states that its full API catalogue is still to be published, so the four named integrations are a floor and not a count. The page carries no date.

summary: The [electronic identity and authentication platform operates behind the justice portal](2026-07-20-cabo-verde-sniac-cartao-nacional-identificacao), supporting three authentication modes.
developments:
The platform is [operating as the state's e-identity layer behind the justice portal, supporting three authentication modes and acting as the civil-registration to identity interoperability layer that assigns a unique identification number at birth](2024-12-19-cpv-lancamento-oficial-do-portal-de-justica).

Its stated next phase is [consolidating existing databases, expanding identity-enabled services and finding long-term financing models](2026-05-19-crvs-id-reforms-birth-registration-biometricupdate), carrying no date, instrument or budget line. That an identity platform doing this much work has no identified long-term financing model, and no appropriation traceable to it in a digital vote that fell by seven eighths across two budgets, is the position as the base holds it.

summary: The [national identification card keeps its 2014 legal basis and 2018 launch design](2026-07-20-cabo-verde-sniac-cartao-nacional-identificacao), now produced domestically and renewable online.
developments:
The card is a [polycarbonate contact smart card created by decree in 2014, with fee regime, biometric capture rules and validity period set by later instruments, its chip carrying identification, authentication and digital-signature applications, officially launched in January 2018](2026-07-20-cabo-verde-sniac-cartao-nacional-identificacao).

Same design and legal basis, now [renewable online through the justice portal](2024-12-19-cpv-lancamento-oficial-do-portal-de-justica) and [produced domestically](2026-06-10-inforpress-incv-producao-documentos-seguranca). No issuance total, coverage rate or holder count is held from any date, so how much of the population carries it is unestablished - which the birth-registration figure recorded elsewhere in this report should not be read as answering.

summary: The state printer [began domestic production of identity documents on 11 June 2026](2026-06-11-cabo-verde-incv-inicia-producao-documentos-identificacao-do-estado).
developments:
[The Imprensa Nacional de Cabo Verde announced on 11 June 2026 that its personalisation centre, inaugurated in December 2024, is fully operational and authorised to issue the Cartao Nacional de Identificacao, the Titulo de Residencia para Estrangeiros and the electronic passport, at a stated daily capacity of 1,200 identity cards and residence titles and 2,400 passports, and an estimated 79,600 cards, 5,000 residence titles and 60,000 passports a year](2026-06-11-cabo-verde-incv-inicia-producao-documentos-identificacao-do-estado). The credential issued off the national civil identification base is now produced in country.

No issued-volume figure against that capacity is held, and nothing states what the external supplier arrangement cost before it.

summary: [SNIAC released card middleware at version 1.9.9](2026-03-17-cabo-verde-sniac-middleware-cni-versao-1-9-9), letting holders use the card's digital functions with institutions.
developments:
[The civil identification and authentication system publishes middleware, at version 1.9.9, that lets a citizen use the digital functions of the identity card in dealings with public and private institutions](2026-03-17-cabo-verde-sniac-middleware-cni-versao-1-9-9). [The residence title for foreign nationals, created by Decreto-Lei 20/2014, was launched under the same system on 29 July 2021](2021-07-29-cabo-verde-sniac-titulo-de-residencia-para-estrangeiros).

[SNIAC is the umbrella system, run from the justice ministry's portal](2020-01-01-cabo-verde-sniac-sistema-nacional-identificacao-autenticacao-civil).

No activation count for the digital credential is held, which the ledger carries as an open row.

summary: Birth registration reached [99%, with a unique identification number issued to every child at birth](2026-05-19-crvs-id-reforms-birth-registration-biometricupdate), from about 91% before the linkage reforms.
developments:
Coverage stood at [about 91% before the linkage reforms, with fragmented systems and weak institutional coordination](2026-05-19-crvs-id-reforms-birth-registration-biometricupdate).

2026-05 - the justice-modernisation institute reported [99% birth registration and 100% registration of deaths occurring in health facilities, reached within five years, with a unique identification number issued to every child at birth](2026-05-19-crvs-id-reforms-birth-registration-biometricupdate).

The figures are the institute's own and are registration coverage, not identity-card coverage. It is the strongest measured position on this ledger, and the only one on it where a stated outcome rather than an instrument has moved.

summary: The central bank [announced SPEED, a national instant-transfer system, for launch in the first quarter of 2026](2025-12-07-cabo-verde-bcv-anuncia-speed-transferencias-instantaneas).
developments:
[The governor of the Banco de Cabo Verde announced SPEED on 5 December 2025, a national immediate-transfer system to launch in the first quarter of 2026, following a pilot completed with four commercial banks and specified to work without internet access](2025-12-07-cabo-verde-bcv-anuncia-speed-transferencias-instantaneas). The bank is acting as architect and coordinator of the infrastructure rather than as its overseer, with costs shared between it, the commercial banks, the regulator and the government.

[SICIL, the integrated interbank clearing and settlement system, is separately described in service by the bank](2019-05-22-cabo-verde-bcv-sicil-interbank-clearing-settlement).

No launch confirmation for SPEED is held, and the base carries nothing on the digital currency the bank said it was separately studying.

progress: No change, a standing system the base holds for the first time
summary: [Rede vinti4 is the national retail switch, and cards were the most-used payment instrument in 2024](2025-09-24-cabo-verde-bcv-relatorio-sistema-pagamentos-2024).
developments:
[The Banco de Cabo Verde's payment-systems report for 2024, reported on 24 September 2025, makes the card the most-used payment instrument in the country, at a daily average of 132,405 card operations worth CVE 553.8m](2025-09-24-cabo-verde-bcv-relatorio-sistema-pagamentos-2024). [Over the 2025 Christmas period Cabo Verdeans moved more than CVE 9bn through the vinti4 network](2025-12-27-cabo-verde-sisp-rede-vinti4-nove-mil-milhoes-festas-natal).

The base holds transaction volumes and no breakdown by instrument type, merchant category or island, and no acceptance-point count.

summary: A [company-lifecycle platform entered beta with a pilot user group in March 2026](2026-03-20-plataforma-empresa-online-digitalizacao-servicos-publicos-expressodasilhas).
developments:
2026-03-20 - a [beta platform for online company-lifecycle procedures was presented at a socialisation ceremony in Mindelo, developed by a private supplier with the registry and notary directorate and resting on interoperability between public systems](2026-03-20-plataforma-empresa-online-digitalizacao-servicos-publicos-expressodasilhas).

No user count, cost or full-launch date is published, and the developer rather than the state describes the interoperability design - which matters because the standards instrument that would govern it was announced for 2024 and never adopted.

summary: The single social registry [now queries held data directly instead of taking paper declarations](2025-12-17-cabo-verde-csu-consulta-directa-de-dados-elimina-declaracoes-papel).
developments:
[The Cadastro Social Unico stopped requiring paper declarations in December 2025 and queries the data directly](2025-12-17-cabo-verde-csu-consulta-directa-de-dados-elimina-declaracoes-papel). [Portaria Conjunta 16/2026 of 13 February 2026 extends it to the allocation of state housing](2026-02-13-cabo-verde-portaria-conjunta-16-2026-csu-habitacao-estado), and [in June 2026 the government called households in climate-vulnerable zones to register in it](2026-06-17-cabo-verde-apelo-registo-csu-zonas-climaticamente-vulneraveis).

[It was created by Decreto Regulamentar 7/2018 and is run by the family and social inclusion ministry](2018-09-20-cabo-verde-mfids-cadastro-social-unico-csu).

No registered-household count and no coverage rate against the population are held.

progress: No change, a standing position the base holds for the first time
summary: [LMITS is functioning and used for most land transactions on four islands](2022-11-01-cabo-verde-mcc-evaluation-lmits-land-management-information-system).
developments:
[An independent evaluation published on 1 November 2022 found the Land Management, Information and Technology System functioning, integrated into the transaction process and used to process most land transactions; it was built under the US$17.5m Land Management for Investment project inside MCC's US$65.6m Cabo Verde II Compact, covering Sal, Boa Vista, Sao Vicente and Maio, and the national land management institute has continued the cadastre work since the compact closed](2022-11-01-cabo-verde-mcc-evaluation-lmits-land-management-information-system). [The territory institute runs the property cadastre as a service of its own](2014-01-01-cabo-verde-ingt-cadastro-predial-registo-administrativo).

No national cadastral coverage figure is held, and nothing states the position on the six islands the compact did not cover.

summary: A [pharmaceutical market monitoring system was launched](2026-07-30-cabo-verde-simfar-pharmaceutical-market-monitoring-platform), and [health-system digitalisation was announced with 24 telemedicine units](2026-07-16-cabo-verde-health-ai).
developments:
2026-07 - the independent health regulator launched [real-time national tracking of the medicines circuit, forecasting stock-outs and triggering replenishment or redistribution, integrated with the customs system to detect illegal imports](2026-07-30-cabo-verde-simfar-pharmaceutical-market-monitoring-platform); no cost, vendor, coverage figure or baseline stock-out rate is published, and it is held from a wire report with no first-party regulator document on file.

Health-system digitalisation was [announced at the handover of 24 telemedicine units: a unique patient identification code granting access to medical history, digital medical records centralised across facilities, and electronic prescriptions](2026-07-16-cabo-verde-health-ai), with no build timetable, cost, vendor or coverage figure. A unique patient identifier is a second identity number alongside the one issued at birth, and nothing on file states how the two relate.

summary: [SIGE was made compulsory for the 2025/26 school year](2025-08-06-cabo-verde-despacho-120-gme-2025-ano-letivo-sige-obrigatorio) and [a US$1m grant funds its expansion](2026-04-08-cabo-verde-gpe-subvencao-prise-expansao-modernizacao-sige).
developments:
[The Global Partnership for Education approved a US$1m grant, 95,625,000 escudos, on 8 April 2026 for the PRISE 2026-2028 programme, whose named technical areas include the expansion and modernisation of the Sistema Integrado de Gestao Escolar](2026-04-08-cabo-verde-gpe-subvencao-prise-expansao-modernizacao-sige). [Despacho 120/GME/2025 made the system compulsory in the instruments regulating the 2025/26 school year](2025-08-06-cabo-verde-despacho-120-gme-2025-ano-letivo-sige-obrigatorio).

[The education ministry's own account dates the pilot to two secondary schools in 2009, dissemination to 2014, and completion across every secondary school in the country to July 2018](2019-02-01-cabo-verde-minedu-sige-sistema-integrado-gestao-escolar).

No enrolment, record or school count is held for the system as it now runs, and nothing states whether basic education is inside it.

summary: The [criminal-process component of the justice information system was handed over and operates in every comarca](2026-03-17-cpv-nosi-entrega-sistema-de-informacao-da-justica).
developments:
The system was [in use by lawyers to reach and track cases without travelling to the comarcas, with design work running with the superior judicial councils since 2021](2024-12-19-cpv-lancamento-oficial-do-portal-de-justica).

2026-03-17 - the [criminal-process system was completed and in operation in every comarca in the country, with maintenance passed from the state operator to the justice-modernisation institute and the civil-process component to begin implementation in April 2026](2026-03-17-cpv-nosi-entrega-sistema-de-informacao-da-justica).

No cost, contract or vendor figure is stated, and no source confirms the civil-process implementation began.

summary: A [single services portal went live on 24 February 2026](2026-02-24-governo-lanca-portal-govcv-modernizar-servicos-publicos-expressodasilhas), against an unmeasured target of 60% of vital services online by 2026.
developments:
2026-02-24 - a [single web and app gateway went live covering finance, civil registration, identity, tax, higher education, transport and social services, with departmental portals to migrate into it](2026-02-24-governo-lanca-portal-govcv-modernizar-servicos-publicos-expressodasilhas); no count of migrated services is published, and the Prime Minister's own account is that departmental platforms did not communicate with each other before that date. It follows the [justice portal launched in December 2024 behind the identity platform, serving land, commercial, vehicle and criminal-record certificates, civil-status certificates, identity-card renewal and appointment booking](2024-12-19-cpv-lancamento-oficial-do-portal-de-justica).

The [target of at least 60% of vital public services online by 2026 and 80% by 2030 was restated at a World Bank mission and remains unmeasured](2025-09-29-world-bank-digital-transformation-support-techafricanews). The [procurement platform was re-let at CVE 70,000,000 over four years on perpetual licensing, unlimited users, national deployment and full source-code control, extended to local administration and mandatory for 2026](2026-03-19-cpv-nota-esclarecimento-plataforma-eletronica-contratacao-publica).

summary: A [municipal council will open a services platform with 17 services by end-2026](2026-08-25-cabo-verde-cmsv-plataforma-digital-municipal-expressodasilhas), funded by a UN joint office.
developments:
2026-08-25 - a council [presented a services platform for public presentation in October 2026 and operation by the end of that year, opening with 17 services on which residents can submit applications, track cases in real time, make payments and receive official documents in digital form with legal validity](2026-08-25-cabo-verde-cmsv-plataforma-digital-municipal-expressodasilhas).

It is funded by a UN joint office, whose resident coordinator called 17 services a good starting point and asked the council to consider integrating further procedures in a second phase, while a minister argued for keeping and improving traditional counter services for those still facing difficulties with digital access, and for replicating the model in other municipalities if it succeeds. It is the only local-government digital instrument the base holds.

summary: A [US$9m contract for artificial-intelligence-assisted port scanning is stated to be under way](2026-01-09-cpv-administracao-tributaria-digital-e-inteligente).
developments:
2026-01-09 - the Finance Minister stated at the Praia customs house that a [US$9m contract for artificial-intelligence-assisted scanning equipment at the national ports is under way, inside a stated programme for a fully digitised national revenue directorate built on artificial intelligence and data management](2026-01-09-cpv-administracao-tributaria-digital-e-inteligente).

Its signature date and counterparty are not established, and the figure is stated in dollars by the announcing minister with no escudo equivalent and no conversion date. It is the only artificial-intelligence deployment of any kind the base records for this country, and it is a procurement statement rather than a system in service.

summary: The Health Minister [proposed the country as a lusophone laboratory for artificial intelligence in health](2026-07-16-cabo-verde-health-ai) at a global conference.
developments:
2026-07-16 - the minister [proposed the country as a lusophone laboratory for artificial intelligence in health, hosting pilot projects integrating it with telemedicine, and called for cooperation on skills, digital infrastructure, interoperability and an ethical and regulatory framework](2026-07-16-cabo-verde-health-ai).

No pilot, partner, budget or instrument is held. It is a ministerial proposal at an international conference rather than a domestic programme, and it was made while the national artificial-intelligence strategy that would frame it was still at kick-off stage with no draft text.

summary: Both [technology park campuses are in operation with 23 companies and 311 professionals](2025-05-07-afdb-techpark-cv-inauguration-press-release), and [phase two went to tender](2026-07-29-cabo-verde-technology-park-phase-ii-afdb-ifb-036).
developments:
The campuses were [inaugurated on 5 and 6 May 2025, each with a data centre, on a EUR 51.85m project of which EUR 45.5m is bank financing](2025-05-06-techpark-cv-inaugurated-wearetech), with [23 companies from seven countries, 311 professionals, full occupancy of 52 office spaces against capacity for up to 1,500, and training programmes up from 6 in 2023 to 50 in the first quarter of 2025 with 2,769 people upskilled](2025-05-07-afdb-techpark-cv-inauguration-press-release). No later tenancy, employment or revenue figure of any kind is held, and all figures are the financier's and the park's own.

The park is a [special economic zone carrying VAT exemption, reduced import duties and a corporate tax rate of 2.5%](2025-05-29-rival-nigeria-ghana-tech-techcabal), with no uptake figure or list of admitted firms held; a [Portuguese information-security firm present since 2007 is the first international company in both campuses](2025-05-31-bruno-castro-visionware-ciberseguranca-techpark-expressodasilhas). Phase two [went to open international bidding on 29 July 2026 with the contract value unpublished](2026-07-29-cabo-verde-technology-park-phase-ii-afdb-ifb-036).

summary: The state innovation body [launched a diaspora initiative in March 2026](2026-03-24-rabida-diaspora-initiative-techreviewafrica) alongside its standing scholarship and startup programmes.
developments:
The body is [stated to support 200 young people a year on scholarships, fund about 100 startups with six minimum salaries for two co-founders, and finance attendance at international events](2025-07-31-boost-cv-startup-ecosystem-wearetech), and is the implementing body named for the diaspora initiative, the public-sector hackathon and the digital-skills rollout. All programme figures are government-reported and unchanged in stated design; the [awards it runs are its most visible output](2025-01-15-digital-awards-cabo-verde-finalistas-expressodasilhas).

2026-03 - it [launched an initiative to connect diaspora entrepreneurs, talent and investment to domestic opportunities, the launch event convened to shape the platform, its structure and operating model presented rather than opened](2026-03-24-rabida-diaspora-initiative-techreviewafrica). No budget, legal basis, target or timetable is held.

progress: Mixed, a public-sector hackathon ran a fresh edition while the science and innovation foundation provided for in the FY2024 budget has not been created
summary: A [2026 hackathon edition ran for public-sector challenges](2026-05-02-reinventa-hackathon-techreviewafrica), while the [foundation allocated for in FY2024 is uncreated](2023-11-08-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2024).
developments:
The hackathon is a [running programme in which startups solve challenges set by public and private institutions](2025-07-31-boost-cv-startup-ecosystem-wearetech); its [two-day 2026 edition ran for public-sector challenges with national and diaspora participants, supported by the World Bank Group, the digital economy ministry, the telecommunications directorate, the state innovation body and the national university, with four teams recognised](2026-05-02-reinventa-hackathon-techreviewafrica). The exact dates are not published.

The [science, innovation and technology foundation provided for by an allocation in the FY2024 budget has not been created, with no evidence of it at 2026-08-06](2023-11-08-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2024). A [university and economy ministry partnership on innovation, entrepreneurship and employment is projected rather than signed, with no scope, funding or programme published](2026-08-18-unicv-ministry-economy-innovation-partnership).

summary: The [national digital-skills strategy is still not adopted a year after its draft workshop](2025-08-08-digital-skills-gdp-boost-techafricanews).
developments:
The strategy was [under preparation inside the World Bank-financed project, informed by a digital-readiness study covering more than a thousand people across several islands, and not adopted](2025-08-08-digital-skills-gdp-boost-techafricanews) when a workshop on the draft was held in Praia.

It is still not adopted: no adoption instrument, publication or target date is held a year later. The readiness study behind it is the only measurement of digital skills across the population the base holds, and its results are not published either. The Secretary of State's claim that stronger digital skills could double national output is an official statement, not a modelled estimate.

summary: A [digital-skills programme opened 1,050 first-phase places against a 3,000-opportunity target](2026-01-30-skodji-digital-launch-techreviewafrica), with no enrolment figure held.
developments:
2026-01 - the programme was [formally launched with 1,050 places in a first phase against a stated 3,000-opportunity target, applications closing 25 February 2026 and training running two to six months, funded by the World Bank through the flagship project at a reported EUR 400,000](2026-01-30-skodji-digital-launch-techreviewafrica), [open to residents and the diaspora against youth unemployment reported at 27.8%](2026-02-02-skodji-digital-skills-wearetech). No enrolment, completion or placement figure is held, [including after the first cohort sessions](2026-05-03-skodji-digital-rollout-gig-economy-techreviewafrica).

A [separate programme launched in July 2025 to back 150 young digital entrepreneurs carries no participant, completion, funding or outcome figure after launch](2025-07-31-boost-cv-startup-ecosystem-wearetech), and the [state operator's academy is reported at about 3,000 applications and more than 600 internships since 2016, both cumulative with no annual breakdown](2026-03-11-cpv-governo-dispoe-10-milhoes-de-contos-para-investir-no-digital).

progress: Mixed, the one-stop-shop earmark rose for FY2026 while the two sub-lines naming physical and one-stop-shop access were dropped
summary: The earmark rose to [CVE 74,050,000 for FY2026 across two sub-lines only](2025-12-31-cpv-lei-69-x-2025-orcamento-do-estado-2026-source), the citizen-space and one-stop-shop lines having disappeared.
developments:
The one-stop shop operated on an [earmarked own-service-fee receipt of CVE 74,817,675 at the FY2024 proposed stage](2023-09-29-cpv-anexo-informativo-oe-2024-receitas-consignadas-source) and was [CVE 59,437,242 for FY2025 across four sub-lines including a citizen-space community line and a one-stop-shop implementation line](2024-12-30-cpv-lei-45-x-2024-orcamento-do-estado-2025-source).

For FY2026 it is [CVE 74,050,000 across two sub-lines only, service quality and new technological infrastructure: the total rose while the two lines naming physical and one-stop-shop access disappeared](2025-12-31-cpv-lei-69-x-2025-orcamento-do-estado-2026-source). It is [still named as a component of the state-modernisation programme](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-modernizacao-estado-administracao-publica), and no service-volume figure is held from any date.

summary: The universal service fund is [appropriated at CVE 122,073,633 for FY2026, identical to the escudo across three budgets](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-fusi).
developments:
The fund is [financed from operator contributions and the radio-spectrum fee, carried in the earmarked-revenue table and in no organic, functional or economic classification](2024-12-30-cpv-2025-fusi), and is [appropriated at CVE 122,073,633 for FY2026, identical to the escudo across FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026](2025-12-31-cpv-2026-fusi) - a [fee-financed ceiling rolled forward rather than re-estimated](2023-09-29-cpv-2024-fusi).

The base holds the appropriation only: no expenditure, project, governing instrument or annual report for the fund from any date. So the one instrument the country has for connecting what the market will not connect cannot be shown to have spent anything.

summary: The [household income and expenditure survey fielded in December 2022 is still unpublished](2026-07-25-anacao-banco-mundial-ine-pobreza-estatisticas) more than three years on.
developments:
Fieldwork began in December 2022 and definitive results were unpublished at the window's opening. They are [still unpublished at 25 July 2026, so the World Bank microsimulated its July 2026 poverty estimate from the 2015 survey; the statistics institute states an under-reporting of food expenditure was identified and corrected, and that a new fully digital survey was planned for July 2026](2026-07-25-anacao-banco-mundial-ine-pobreza-estatisticas).

No source records the replacement survey starting. A poverty figure microsimulated from a survey eleven years old is the practical consequence, and the [institute has separately rejected accusations bearing on its technical independence](2026-06-01-ine-rejeita-acusacoes-manipulacao-independencia-tecnica-expressodasilhas).

The two headline series are not comparable: the [institute's extreme-poverty rate of 2.28% for 2023 sits against World Bank estimates of 53.8% for 2024 and a projected 49.2% for 2026, the difference being which threshold was applied rather than any change in living conditions](2026-07-25-anacao-banco-mundial-ine-pobreza-estatisticas).

summary: An [independent evaluation of the statistics institute was ordered over alleged data manipulation](2026-08-03-inecv-rejeita-acusacoes-manipulacao-dados), and [no audited state account exists after 2023](2026-05-15-cpv-conta-provisoria-i-trimestre-2026-source).
developments:
The integrity dispute stood as [anonymous technicians' allegations of August 2025](2025-08-10-estatisticos-alertam-enganados-pelo-ine-anacao) against the [institute's rejection of September 2025](2025-09-17-ine-repudia-acusacoes-manipulacao-dados-expressodasilhas). 2026-08-03 - the Prime Minister [ordered an evaluation to establish alleged interference and manipulation of data, which the institute's board said it would host, offering all technical documentation](2026-08-03-inecv-rejeita-acusacoes-manipulacao-dados); nothing is established about its terms of reference, who conducts it, when it reports, or whether findings will be published.

Separately, the [audit court's published opinion series ends at the FY2023 account, so the 2024 general account published in September 2025 remains unaudited and the finest published record of digital spending is the executive's own quarterly provisional account](2026-05-15-cpv-conta-provisoria-i-trimestre-2026-source).

summary: A [transparency portal completed public consultation in July 2025](2025-06-27-cpv-portal-da-transparencia-em-consulta-publica), and a [statistics access protocol was signed with a university](2026-03-29-ine-universidade-coimbra-cooperacao-estatistica-expressodasilhas).
developments:
The transparency portal was [built and out to public consultation from 27 June to 17 July 2025, discharging the statutory duty to create a publicly accessible electronic platform, its declared scope covering central government, local government and state enterprises in one portal with downloads in six formats and data exchange by interface](2025-06-27-cpv-portal-da-transparencia-em-consulta-publica). No source establishes whether it went live after the consultation closed. It was designed and implemented by the finance ministry's own directorates with donor technical support, naming no vendor.

2026-03 - a [cooperation protocol was formalised providing mechanisms for scientific access to statistical data including metadata and anonymised microdata subject to data-protection rules and statistical secrecy, covering research projects, theses, publications and exchange of expertise](2026-03-29-ine-universidade-coimbra-cooperacao-estatistica-expressodasilhas); no access portal, request procedure or first dataset is named.

summary: Selection for a [third compact directed at connectivity was stated in the FY2025 budget speech](2024-11-06-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2025); no compact document is held.
developments:
The country was [selected for a third compact, stated as directed at connectivity in transport, services and digital with the African continent](2024-11-06-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2025).

Nothing has moved: no compact document, size, signature date or programme detail is held at 2026-08-06. It is the only United States government instrument the base names for this country, and it exists only as a sentence in a budget speech nearly two years old.

summary: A [third phase of the surveillance programme was financed by China at about EUR 9.3m](2026-08-15-cabo-verde-china-cidade-segura-fase3), its implementation agreement signed in August 2026.
developments:
2026-08 - phase three was [financed at about EUR 9.3m in non-reimbursable assistance, the implementation agreement signed by the interior minister and the Chinese ambassador at the National Police Command Centre in Praia, covering command centres, data centres and wireless base stations at three towns and expanded video surveillance in Praia and Mindelo](2026-08-15-cabo-verde-china-cidade-segura-fase3), [recorded on the financier's side](2026-08-01-china-mofcom-cpv-004-cidade-segura-phase-3). No camera count, retention rule, data-protection authorisation or oversight arrangement is published for any phase.

Phase two was an [RMB 92.5 million grant committed in 2019 extending the network to three islands plus a further 100 poles in Praia and installing a 4G police network](2019-01-01-china-mofcom-cpv-003-chinese-government-provides-rmb-925-million), with no statement of operating status since. 2026-07-29 - a [vendor delegation was received by the Prime Minister and Finance Minister, the existing partnership reviewed and a new representative introduced, with no agreement, project, sum or timetable named](2026-07-29-governo-cv-huawei-cooperacao-transformacao-digital).

summary: A [EUR 300 million gateway package stated in the FY2025 budget speech has no signed instrument, allocation or disbursement](2024-11-06-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2025).
developments:
A [digital-transformation pillar and a cybersecurity strand were stated as intentions in the FY2024 budget speech](2023-11-08-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2024), and a [EUR 300 million gateway package in the FY2025 speech](2024-11-06-cpv-discurso-primeiro-ministro-debate-oe2025). Neither has a signed instrument, allocation or disbursement held, and these are intentions stated in budget speeches rather than appropriations.

What did happen is smaller and specific: [European Union representatives took part in the data and artificial-intelligence strategy kick-off of 28 April 2026](2026-05-04-national-data-ai-strategies-techafricanews), and the [telecom guarantee resolution of 20 April 2026 invokes the gateway framing](2026-04-21-estado-aval-37-milhoes-cvtelecom-telecomunicacoes-expressodasilhas).

progress: No change, nothing on the record after 2010
summary: India's one engagement of record is the [Pan-African e-Network, inaugurated in Praia on 29 July 2010](2010-07-29-cabo-verde-pan-african-e-network-inaugurado-na-praia).
developments:
[The Pan-African e-Network was inaugurated in Praia on 29 July 2010, implemented by the Indian state company TCIL with NOSi and financed by the Government of India, connecting Cabo Verdean institutions over fibre and satellite to a TCIL data centre and studio in New Delhi, to twelve Indian hospitals and seven Indian universities, and to five regional African universities and five hospitals, for tele-education, telemedicine, videoconferencing, internet access and e-government](2010-07-29-cabo-verde-pan-african-e-network-inaugurado-na-praia).

The base carries nothing on the network after that date — no operating report, no closure notice, and no later Indian line of credit, technical-cooperation record or forum commitment naming Cabo Verde.

progress: No change, a first published coverage count
summary: [380,545 cards and 13,249 terminals](2025-09-24-cabo-verde-bcv-relatorio-sistema-pagamentos-2024) against 232 cash machines, on the central bank's own 2024 report.
developments:
The [payments report for 2024](2025-09-24-cabo-verde-bcv-relatorio-sistema-pagamentos-2024) is the base's first consolidated coverage figure for Cabo Verde: 380,545 cards, 13,249 point-of-sale terminals and 232 cash machines, with 132,405 daily operations worth CVE 553.8m.

It also records an instant transfer pilot under way, which is the next rail rather than a measure of use. No earlier comparable figure is held, so the direction of travel cannot be stated.

summary: [419,755 electors](2026-04-30-cabo-verde-dgape-boe-republicacao-mapa-eleitores) on the roll at 28 April 2026, published by constituency in the gazette.
developments:
The [global electorate map](2026-04-30-cabo-verde-dgape-boe-republicacao-mapa-eleitores) puts the roll at 419,755 electors at its reference date of 28 April 2026, broken down by constituency.

It reaches the base as a republication: the original gazette text of 28 April was found inexact and the full corrected table was reissued two days later, which is the register's own correction mechanism working in public.

summary: The tax and customs authority's [first governing board was appointed](2026-07-31-cabo-verde-boe-resolucao-36-2026-nomeacao-atcv) with effect from 1 August 2026.
developments:
The [resolution approved in council on 29 July 2026](2026-07-31-cabo-verde-boe-resolucao-36-2026-nomeacao-atcv) appoints the members of the authority's governing board with effect from 1 August, which is the body constituted rather than the register moved.

No taxpayer count or registration series is published against it.
